species.real: The Montserrat oriole lives nowhere else on Earth, and it slings its nest under a broad leaf such as a heliconia, sewn on with plant fibres.
species.name: Oriolet

dex.text: Black and gold and singing from the top of the highest tree, like a tiny bishop on a bender. Hid in the hills while the mountain misbehaved.
dex.fact: The Montserrat oriole, black and yellow, is the island's national bird; it survived the volcano in the Centre Hills, the forest that escaped the ashfall.
